name: Rarities
description: Real-card showcase prints: broken frames, full art and alternate artworks.
details: Needs Shiny=1 (Yu-Gi-Oh-Core). Over Rush Rare: the card's real extended-art (over-frame) print, the art breaking out of its frame. Full Over Rush Rare: the art over the whole card. Every card pulled comes in one of its printed artworks. ShinyPreview=over-rush, full-over-rush or alt1 shows them on every card. Made by Tools/Scripts/make_fullframe_mod.py, fetch_extended_art.py and fetch_alt_arts.py.
